purpose: Network variants of adsb_nn2's declared development and refit fits with tools/run_adsb_nn2.py; settings copied unchanged from the October design configuration (configs/adsb_nn2_design_v1.json), so every variant hash equals its design runs'. nnl: the v24 network (nnb) with LIRF's ordinary rows in fitting, the LIRF fill population still excluded. nmres: nnb trained on label minus the NM clock proxy where the clock is present. Further nnb seeds use the unchanged configs/adsb_nn_network_v1.json and tools/run_adsb_nn.py, so they are the same recipe as v24's sixteen.
